description: This file is a shell script (`.sh`) that implements a utility for managing telemetry data collection and transmission on a device. It includes functions to gather device information, manage telemetry configurations, schedule tasks via cron, communicate with other system components, and handle log uploads. The script orchestrates telemetry reporting, cleanup, and system interactions, indicating its role in device telemetry and diagnostics management.

methods.name: dcaCleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup of telemetry-related files and markers, including stopping background processes and removing temporary telemetry data directories.

methods.name: pidCleanup
methods.description: Removes the PID file for the utility, indicating the process is no longer running.

methods.name: isNum
methods.description: Checks whether a given argument is a numeric value.

methods.name: getEstbMac
methods.description: Retrieves the device's Ethernet MAC address via `dmcli` or network interface commands.

methods.name: getErouterIpv4
methods.description: Retrieves the IPv4 address of the erouter0 interface using `dmcli`.

methods.name: getErouterIpv6
methods.description: Retrieves the IPv6 address of the erouter0 interface using `dmcli`.

methods.name: getSNMPUpdates
methods.description: Performs SNMP walk to retrieve specified MIB values and sums the results.

methods.name: getControllerId
methods.description: Uses SNMP to gather controller-specific identifiers from the device.

methods.name: getRFStatus
methods.description: Uses SNMP to get RF signal status parameters like power levels and SNR.

methods.name: processJsonResponse
methods.description: Processes a JSON response file, reformats it, and extracts telemetry configuration data.

methods.name: scheduleCron
methods.description: Schedules or updates a cron job for telemetry data collection based on configuration.

methods.name: dropbearRecovery
methods.description: Ensures SSH server (dropbear) is running, restarting if needed.

methods.name: clearTelemetryConfig
methods.description: Removes telemetry configuration and marker files to reset telemetry state.

methods.name: generateTelemetryConfig
methods.description: Generates telemetry configuration files based on input JSON profiles, creating map files for telemetry patterns.
